tagline: Touch up the UI your agent drafted
brief: A visual canvas that lets developers fix small UI details on the page itself and writes each edit back to their source. It should feel crafted and calm, not generic dev-tool or AI-looking.
criteria: Success: distinct from the usual dev-tool marks, readable at 16 px, works in one colour, matches the Ivory and serif UI.

concepts.name: Italic b
concepts.idea: A serif italic b over a loaded-brush swipe: the letter finished by hand.
rationale: Editorial letterform and wordmark match the Ivory interface
One vermilion swipe is the whole brand: the touch-up
Heavier small-size cut keeps it readable as a 16 px favicon
Works in one colour as a solid letter on a hollow ribbon

next_steps: Use brand/icons for the favicon and app icon
Follow GUIDELINES.md for spacing and colour
